rules.statement: GRIN2B nonsense variants are associated with mild developmental delay without epilepsy, within the developmental delay or intellectual disability without epilepsy phenotype, rather than developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.
rules.exceptions: Only one patient with a nonsense variant was reported in the source.

sources.quote: The phenotype of 9 cases was developmental delay or intellectual disability without epilepsy, age of visit 1 year to 6 year and 4 months of whom 5 cases had severe developmental delay, 2 cases had moderate and 2 cases had mild delay.

Missense variants were found in 10 patients, among them 6 cases had severe developmental delay, 3 cases had moderate and 1 case had mild developmental delay, but the patient with nonsense variant showed mild developmental delay without epilepsy.

items.item: Condition: the rule is about GRIN2B variants that are nonsense (stop-gain) variants.
items.reason: Quote [2] mentions one patient with a nonsense variant, but not GRIN2B nonsense variants as a rule.

items.item: Conclusion: such variants point to intellectual disability, autosomal dominant 6 (also called: GRIN2B autosomal dominant non-syndromic intellectual disability; GRIN2B encephalopathy; GRIN2B-related developmental delay, intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder; GRIN2B-related neurodevelopmental disorder; MRD6; autosomal dominant non-syndromic intellectual disability caused by mutation in GRIN2B; intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 6, with or without seizures; intellectual disability, autosomal dominant type 6) rather than developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 27 (also called: DEE27; EIEE27; GRIN2B early infantile epileptic encephalopathy; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 27; early infantile epileptic encephalopathy caused by mutation in GRIN2B; epileptic encephalopathy, early infantile, 27; epileptic encephalopathy, early infantile, type 27).
items.reason: The quotes describe one nonsense-variant patient with mild developmental delay without epilepsy but do not classify this as MRD6 or contrast it with DEE27.

items.item: Scope: this is stated as a general association for such GRIN2B variants, not only for a single reported patient or family, and not only as a difference in frequency between patient groups.
items.reason: The evidence for nonsense variants is only a single reported patient, not a general association across such variants.

review.reason: Based on a single patient with a nonsense variant (strength weak); the source does not establish that GRIN2B nonsense variants point to ID6 rather than DEE27.
